mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, stimulating demand for equities and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and weak economic activity, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both below 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a high level of industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 with slowing growth (growth rate < 0.5%) signals an overheating economy and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO > 105 and growth rate < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained consumer price inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting central bank tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending power and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.1% and UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
